description: Permanently remove one or more tasks from a trip checklist. Get checklist_id and the item IDs from trip_checklists. Confirm with the user before removing. To delete a whole checklist use segment_delete. Never show IDs to users.

checklist_id.description: The checklist note's segment ID (checklist_id from trip_checklists).

item_ids.description: IDs of the tasks to remove (itemId from trip_checklists).

name: checklist_items_remove
title: Remove Checklist Items
